caption: The drawing depicts a section of a quilt design featuring a large circular starburst pattern composed of alternating pink and green elongated triangles radiating outward from a central pink circle, which has a quilted diamond texture. The background within the main section of the quilt is filled with a series of curved, feather-like motifs stitched in light gray or off-white lines. The outer border of the quilt shows three parallel bands, colored pink, peach, and green from the interior outward, with darker stitching patterns visible across them. The quilt's boundary is outlined with a single wavy green line. In the bottom left corner of the image, there is a small inset rectangle containing four simplified, hand-drawn versions of the starburst motif, each outlined in light gray or black against a plain background, with no color fill. The primary color scheme of the drawing is pink, green, peach, and off-white, with the stitching and outlines mostly shown in gray or darker shades of the main colors. The drawing is presented on a light beige or cream-colored background.
title: Quilt
